title: Toward Hardware-Grounded Energy Estimation for KWOK: Calibrating Simulated Kubernetes Nodes Against RAPL and NVML (reproduction package)
description:
Reproduction package of the paper Toward Hardware-Grounded Energy Estimation for KWOK: Calibrating Simulated Kubernetes Nodes Against RAPL and NVML. It contains the energy layer for KWOK (a per-component CPU package, DRAM and GPU model calibrated against Intel RAPL and NVIDIA NVML, a Prometheus exporter and trace replay), the measurement harness, the live KWOK experiment (up to 10,000 nodes), the dataset of both capture sessions (raw per-interval traces of 20 workloads x 5 repetitions on two multi-GPU servers, session timelines, fitted coefficients and manifests with the sha256 of every file) and a Docker environment that regenerates every number and table of the paper from the dataset and checks them against the published ones. Code under MIT, data under CC BY 4.0.
